_readme: MASTER TRACKER — Check this file before starting any research task. Claim a restaurant by changing status to 'in_progress' and adding your name to 'assignee'. This prevents duplicate work across parallel Cowork sessions.

restaurants.name: Gardenia
restaurants.notes: 18 items across White Bread, Wholemeal Bread, Specialty Bread, Wraps, Bakery Snacks and Beverages categories. All macros T1 official_sg, sourced directly from per-product Nutritional Information panels on gardenia.com.sg (Singapore's largest bread manufacturer). Prices matched to live fairprice.com.sg listings where an exact SKU exists (8 of 18 items); remaining items use approximate SG retail price estimates, flagged in nutritionNote. Halal tag applied only to the 8 items with an unambiguous exact-match FairPrice SKU showing the official Halal badge — deliberately left off 2 items (Nutri Multi-Grain Loaf, California Raisin Loaf) that FairPrice lists without the badge, and left unconfirmed on items not sold on FairPrice. Sambal Ikan Bilis Bun excluded from vegetarian (contains anchovy/shrimp). No admin approval needed. Four product pages (Ciabatta, Hamburger Buns, Hotdog Buns, Wholemeal Hamburger Buns) returned blank on fetch and were skipped — candidates for a future session.

restaurants.name: Mr Bean
restaurants.notes: 23 items across Soya Milk, Grass Jelly, Soya Ice Cream, Beancurd, Eggwich, Pancakes, Riceball, Millet Grains Soy Porridge and Wholegrain Mixed Rice Bowl categories. All macros T1 official_sg, sourced directly from per-product Nutrition Information panels on mrbean.com.sg/product-info/*. Outlet-level halal tag applied (MUIS-certified since June 2022, confirmed via multiple independent SG news sources) except the Mr Bean x Udders soy ice cream collab item, where halal status was not separately confirmed. Prices are estimates from third-party SG menu-price trackers (sgfoodprice.org, menu-sg.com) since mrbean.com.sg product-info pages do not list prices — flagged in nutritionNote on items without a directly matched price. No admin approval needed.
